description: This file contains unit tests for custom grain placement strategies in an Orleans-based distributed system, including fixed silo placement, exclusion, request context-based placement, and hash-based placement.

classes.name: CustomPlacementTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for custom grain placement strategies in Orleans.

classes.description: Sets up the test cluster environment with custom placement strategies.

classes.description: Configures silo options and services for testing.

methods.description: Configures silo builder with messaging options and services.

methods.name: CustomPlacement_FixedSilo
